findings.location: Proof, step 1.1: the product formula for the inner product of two coordinate characters uses the index range j<n.
findings.evidence: With the standard coordinates j=1,...,n, this range omits the nth coordinate; for n=1 it is empty, so the displayed equality gives 1 even when k!=l, rather than the required Kronecker delta. The proof needs the product over all coordinates j=1,...,n, using one-dimensional orthonormality in each factor. The one-index correction is immediate, so this proof defect is nonfatal.
